categories.main_business_segments: D.I Corporation operates primarily in semiconductor inspection equipment manufacturing and sales, electronic components manufacturing, environmental facilities, audio-video equipment, and secondary battery equipment. The semiconductor equipment segment is the core business, producing various testers and boards essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes. The company also engages in electromagnetic wave shielding products, water treatment equipment, high-end audio equipment import and sales, and energy storage system (ESS) related secondary battery equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies in semiconductor inspection equipment such as Burn-In Testers, Wafer Memory Testers, and Logic Burn-In Testers, developed through in-house R&D and strategic partnerships (e.g., with Japanese firms). It employs precision manufacturing and assembly techniques for high-reliability semiconductor test systems and electronic components like electromagnetic shielding and thermal interface materials. R&D efforts focus on software development for testing, automation, and next-generation equipment, including AI-based vision inspection for secondary batteries.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international semiconductor manufacturers requiring front-end and back-end inspection equipment, electronic device manufacturers needing electromagnetic interference solutions, and companies in the secondary battery and energy storage sectors. The company serves industries such as semiconductor fabrication, digital electronics, telecommunications, military electronics, and high-end audio markets. Major end markets are semiconductor fabrication plants, electronic product manufacturers, and energy storage system providers.
categories.geographic_coverage: D.I Corporation operates primarily in South Korea with manufacturing and R&D facilities in Seoul, Ansan, and other locations. It has subsidiaries and affiliates in Japan, China (Suzhou), Poland, and Vietnam, supporting overseas sales and production. The company actively participates in international semiconductor equipment exhibitions and exports products globally, including to Taiwan and Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying semiconductor inspection and test equipment essential for quality assurance in semiconductor fabrication. It also produces electronic components used in final electronic products and secondary battery manufacturing equipment, positioning itself as a key equipment and component supplier rather than an upstream raw material provider or downstream end-product manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing semiconductor inspection equipment technology, developing next-generation Burn-In Testers and wafer-level testers, and expanding into the secondary battery equipment market leveraging AI and machine vision. R&D initiatives emphasize software development for testing automation, high-speed and high-capacity testing capabilities, and domestic localization of previously imported equipment. The company also invests in electromagnetic wave shielding materials and thermal management solutions to support evolving electronic device requirements.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of semiconductor inspection equipment, electronic components, environmental systems, and secondary battery equipment. The company also earns income from repair services, equipment leasing, and exports. Sales are conducted via direct transactions with manufacturers, with payment terms typically involving upfront and post-inspection payments. The company has expanded online sales channels for audio-video products and pursues strategic partnerships to enhance market reach.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: D.I Corporation holds a competitive position in the domestic semiconductor inspection equipment market, particularly in Burn-In Boards where it commands a leading market share (around 36%). Competitors include domestic firms like UniTest, YIK, NeoSem, Exicon, and international players. The company differentiates itself through long-standing experience, technological partnerships, and a broad product portfolio. In electronic components, it is recognized as a top-tier domestic supplier with advanced EMC solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 214.5 billion KRW with an operating profit of 6.1 billion KRW, marking a 7% revenue decline and 45% operating profit decrease compared to the previous year due to conservative investment cycles in subsidiaries' markets. The company maintains a solid financial structure with a debt ratio of 74% and a current ratio of 160%. It has sustained over 20 billion KRW in annual sales for three consecutive years and is investing in growth areas like secondary battery equipment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: D.I Corporation emphasizes its 60+ years of expertise in semiconductor inspection equipment, offering domestically developed, high-reliability Burn-In Testers and test boards that reduce import costs and improve production yields. Its products feature advanced software and hardware integration, high-speed testing capabilities, and customization to customer specifications. The company also provides comprehensive electromagnetic shielding solutions and is expanding into the growing secondary battery equipment market, leveraging synergies from semiconductor technology and AI-based inspection systems.
